headline: Possible changes to the Council Rules and Ethics Ordinance, including the timeline for publishing City Council agendas.
summary: The agenda also lists draft minutes from October 20, 2026 for approval, along with an overview from Councilor Kretovic. The meeting is open to the public, but there is no public input or testimony.
